title: feat(studio): the top bar reads ‹ Back to app · APP · Studio; home icon, package switcher and Open app removed
body:
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9JpRoUZGqtwqMU5k7b4C58D)_ Fixes #36501 Clause-②: no Metadata-protocol: none ## 维护者速读 - Studio 的设计人员会看到：左上角从「首页图标 + 应用切换」变成「‹ 返回应用 · 应用名 · Studio」，右上角的「打开应用」没有了，点返回会回到进 Studio 之前那一页。 - 为什么做：外壳专题（去掉顶栏和平台首页）第 12 项，按设计板图 47 让 Studio 的出口只剩一个、回到原来的应用。 - 出错会怎样：设计人员点返回可能到错页面或回到默认首页；改动只在界面层，直接撤回这次合并即可恢复原样。 - 要你做什么：这次改动行数超过三千行（大部分是删掉随切换器一起退场的旧测试），按规则需要你本人批准后才能合并。 ## What changes - `StudioBackToApp` (new) draws the top bar's left end: 「‹ Back to app」, the app's name, and the "Studio" mark. Where it goes, first match wins: 1. **Came from an app** — `ConsoleLayout` records the app page in view on every app route (`utils/appReturnPage.ts`, module memory, never browser storage); the link names that app and returns to that exact page, query and hash kept. 2. **Opened directly** (a Studio URL in a new tab, a reload — module memory starts empty) — the package's first **published** app, on its first screen (`/apps/PACKAGE` for a one-app package, `/apps/APPNAME` for the first of several, the same addressing the removed Open app used). 3. **No published app** (none, or a draft-only app, which has no running front-end) and the organization-flows scope — 「‹ Back to app」 with **no name**, to the console's default landing (`useHomePath()`: the declared default app, else the single app, else the launcher — the same policy `/` resolves). Leaving asks first when a pillar holds unsaved work (`confirmLeavePillar`, the header's existing guard). - Removed from the top bar: the Studio-home button, the package switcher (`PackageSwitcher` component), and the top-right Open app (`StudioOpenApp.tsx`, deleted). `PackageSwitcher.tsx` keeps only the three helpers other code still imports (`PACKAGE_LIST_TOAST_ID`, `STUDIO_LANDING_PATH`, `fetchInstalledPackageRow`); `offeredPackages` and `STUDIO_PKG_READONLY_WORD` had no other reader and went with it. - i18n (studio catalogue, en + zh): `engine.studio.backToApp` (Back to app / 返回应用), `engine.studio.backToAppTitle`, `engine.studio.backToAppTitleNoApp`, `engine.studio.mark`; the three Open app keys are removed; `engine.studio.app.willOpenAfterPublish` names 「Back to app」 instead of Open app. - Untouched: the pillar switcher, the rails, the right slot / AI panel, Changes and Publish. The report/widget publish region (#36420's) is not touched. ## Tests - New `StudioDesignSurface.backToApp-36501.test.tsx` (real surface + real metadata client over a fetch stub): came-from-app names that app and returns to its page with the query; an app other than the package's own is the one named; opened directly names the published app and lands on its home; several apps → the first, by name; no app → no name, to the landing; draft-only app counts as none; the home icon, the switcher and Open app are absent; narrow-bar classes (the name truncates, the link and the mark do not); `studioBackTarget` order unit cases. - `pillarNavGuard`: the Studio-home guard case became 「Back to app」 — dirty → confirm, cancel keeps the matrix edit, confirm leaves; clean → no prompt. - New `fetchInstalledPackageRow-7881.test.ts`: the objectui#7881 / objectui#7938 wire cases, asserted at the helper the Studio landing's Manage still reads. - Updated (each asserted on a removed control): `homeLoop-12513`, `narrowHeader-12509`, `desktopHint-11795`, `entryReadsOnce-11797`, `noAppPackageLabel-12718`, `notFound-26708`, `readOnlyPosture-12453`, `kernelReadOnly-29567`, `packageLessFlows-11553`, `oneSurface-28572`, `autosaveSwitch-11232`, `packageListErrorPosture`; e2e live `studio-customize-journey` (read-only chip line) and `studio-object-designer` (F1, the switcher's create-package refresh, removed). - Deleted (their subject code is deleted): `openApp-34593` (its kernel-row list CONTROL moved into the new file), `narrowChip-12611`, `packageDeletionInference`, `manageSnapshotRefresh` (the switcher's own `onManageChanged`), `packageLookupFailure`, `packageUserMessage` (their wire cases moved to `fetchInstalledPackageRow-7881`). - `homeRecoveryRedirectsFollowDeclaration-7373`: the Studio site now reads `StudioBackToApp.tsx` (where the header's no-app landing reads `useHomePath()`); its behavioural pointer moves from the deleted `packageDeletionInference` to the new back-link test. - Six edited surface tests gained the module-top `import '@objectstack/lint'` that `check:test-source-alias` asks of an edited file reaching the surface.
Local gate readings (derived by dispatch-gates.mjs --commands, HEAD a07beaa37) 37 derived `check:*` / self-test commands ran outside the lock: 35 at EXIT=0; `check:test-source-alias` was red (EXIT=1, the six files above) and is green after the fix (`check-test-source-alias OK — ... the source reach judged 36 test file(s) changed since 9abc732132`); `check:type-check-debt` exited 3 (its closure build waits on the shared verification lock and did not get it): NOT MEASURED locally, CI runs it. `check:nul-bytes` OK (27026 files, no raw control bytes).
- **NOT MEASURED locally: the vitest run of `views/studio-design/`, the 7373 scan, `layout/`, and the app-shell `type-check`.** The shared verification lock was held by a full dogfood battery for over 75 minutes, then by a ten-deep build queue; every acquisition this round timed out. The readings land in the `os-dev-report` comment on #36501 if a later acquisition succeeds; CI's Test UI and type-check runs are the verdict otherwise. ## Acceptance notes - **Size**: +/- lines exceed 3,000 (mostly deletions of the switcher and its pins), so this lands the Tier H way (an authorized approval). - **Lost from the Studio top bar with the switcher** (all still reachable on the Studio landing, which the app sidebar's "Build with AI" opens): New package, Package info and settings, the organization flows entry, and the chip's read-only lock (the item header's read-only mark stays in every pillar) and package-list failure marker (the failure still toasts on the shared id). - Opened directly, the old Open app landed on the surface in focus (`?surface=`, e.g. that object's list); 「Back to app」 lands on the app's first screen, as the card asks. The `app-shell` README paragraph on the way back is rewritten to match. - The package name is no longer printed in the top bar; for a package with no app nothing names it there. - Now-unreferenced switcher catalogue keys (`engine.studio.pkg.switchTitle`, `pkg.heading`, `pkg.none`, `pkg.new`, `pkg.withPair`, `org.hint`, `pkg.manage`) are left in place for a dead-key sweep; `packageApp`'s `icon` / `branding` (read only by the removed chip) are left as well. - **NOT MEASURED: browser before/after screenshots and the 1280 / 1440 no-wrap reading** the card asks for — no browser run in this container this round (the shared verification lock was held by a full dogfood run). The no-wrap contract is pinned by class in the new test. ## Verification Read first: `StudioBackToApp.tsx` (`studioBackTarget`, the three-way order), `ConsoleLayout.tsx` (the one recording effect), the header block in `StudioDesignSurface.tsx`. Two-minute check: open an object's list in an app, enter Studio from it, click 「‹ Back to app」 — you land on the same list; reload Studio and click again — you land on the package app's first screen. 🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code) https://claude.ai/code/session_01ADHkmRY38EZf38Yy3zthbY
